north_star: Quantify retained capability and memory reacquisition through repeated interruptions under bounded observed-only memory.
hypothesis: Y039 interrupted nine-slot retention saved modest churn in four nonaliased schedules; smaller cache budgets and additional resets will erode or sometimes negate benefits. Test the full frozen capacity × reset severity frontier without post-result selection.
freeze: All three cache capacities (3/6/9), four reset schedules, four drift regimes, matched sham/full policies, seed splits and classification criteria frozen before first use; no policies tuned based on Y039 heldout.
environment: Same Y039/Y037 SHA256-keyed independent 7-active of16 motif schedule, 16 cells, circular radius2 and four-way collision; 8 episodes per seed; fixed nonaliased environment fingerprints.
arms: full legal observed cache reads with same write schedule and identical reset event timing
metrics: All 48 capacity/reset/regime cells: heldout returning-key assignment churn sham/full, per-seed and per-episode difference, search calls, legal observed preferences, cache write/key parity and independent exhaustive Hall matching.
classification: BOUNDED_RECOVERY if cap9 double-reset memory saves churn in >=3 of4 drift regimes AND saves >=25% of cap9 no-reset memory savings in >=3 such regimes; PARTIAL if cap9 double reset saves churn in at least2 regimes but strict fails; NO_RECOVERY otherwise. Retain all negative/no-effect cells and report reset/capacity interaction.
controls: All memory cleared at reset starts before matching; evaluator-only history remains for score, never policy inputs
No future events or future labels and no oracle beyond final evaluator Hall matching
Same <=9 inactive memory bound, seven active, sixteen motif/cells unchanged
Exact parent/prereg/source identity, one first-use artifact then complete Python pytest regression
claim_limit: Finite synthetic memory reconstitution under interruption, not biological repair or learned semantic cognition.
